reviewedBy: Claude Opus 5 — split the ZIP signing key off the database credential, verified both halves live
method: Exercised the album download end to end through a real browser against production, not from code reading. Before the change: the deployed app minted a URL and the newly deployed worker returned 200 application/zip, proving the outgoing secret still validates so no download breaks during rollout. After: a signature minted independently with node crypto (against the worker's WebCrypto) also returned 200 application/zip, a tampered signature returned 403 Invalid signature, and a stale timestamp returned 403 Signature expired. The bulk download button's only caller sends quality=large, which is the sole value the worker builds and the same variant the gallery srcset already serves, so the new allowlist rejects nothing a visitor can send. No reader-facing copy changed.
